_about: Search ranking (Phase 3, pulled forward 6 Oct 2026): did each investigation search deliver the piece that holds the needed fact? For every question, each fact names its 'homes': which specialist search (sop = SOP, maintenance = Work Instruction, ncr = NCR, alarm = Shift Log) can deliver it, and evidence phrases taken word for word from that document. A piece is a hit when it contains ALL phrases of a home (case and spacing ignored). A fact is DELIVERED when any home's search puts such a piece in what the app actually hands the specialist (today: top 4, score >= 0.4). Phrases, not piece ids, so the labels survive re-cutting the documents (section chunking). Sets: teaching (3 wordings), fl101 (graph value cases FL-01..05), fresh (graph-chapter fresh questions; tuned on since 6 Oct). The user's 3 set-aside questions get labels only AFTER the search fix: they are the held-out check.
